        #Pick 2 same color (5) - Red, Blue, Green, Black, White

        #Pick 1 color (5) - Red, Blue, Green, Black, White

    Total -> 20

# Reserve a Card: 
        1 of 15 (since you can top deck) 

    Total -> 15

# Buy a card:
        1 of 15 (since you can buy reserved cards)

    Total -> 15

# Discard a Gem:
        1 of 6 (Since you have to discard one of the 6 colors)
    
    Total -> 6

        1 of 5
